headline_bound: On r47's |d|>1/228 branch, a Schur cross block with Z2 and h<=1/2 gives ||p_Q||inf<140.828209 Z2^(-1/8); failure at h=3/4 forces one physical Schur row/column pair to carry >Z2/2. The exact-target two-star family has Z2=1 and ||p_Q||inf<=4sqrt(2e), while every physical E3 and E5 vanish and all individual 2x2 minors shrink; nevertheless integral |phi_Q|<=74.433830 uniformly.
